provenance.compiled_from: The cyclic volatile methylsiloxanes: observed in ambient and indoor air, and a classic background of mass spectrometry inlets, which the list's background tag says on every row it names (Schlosser and Volkmer-Engert 2003). D3 to D6 as measured in air worldwide (Genualdi et al. 2011); D7 and D8 as measured in indoor air (Fromme et al. 2019). Formulas checked against PubChem.
